title: Advocates Act, 1961 — Section 38 (Appeal to the Supreme Court)

content.overview: Section 38 provides an appeal to the Supreme Court against an order of the disciplinary committee of the Bar Council of India.
content.glance: Section 38 provides an appeal to the Supreme Court against an order of the disciplinary committee of the Bar Council of India.
content.study: Any person aggrieved by an order of the disciplinary committee of the Bar Council of India made under section 36 or 37, or the Attorney-General or the Advocate-General, may within sixty days prefer an appeal to the Supreme Court.

sections.body: Section 38 provides an appeal to the Supreme Court against an order of the disciplinary committee of the Bar Council of India.
